question: Who touched this line last, and why?

claims.text: The last person to touch the delay line was Tom Haskell, in August 2024. It was a rename-only refactor. He pulled the 3000 into a PAUSE_MS constant and renamed the variables. The wait itself stayed.
I wrote the original delay in 2020. The tax vendor returned 429 when two requests from one account landed within 3 seconds, and without the wait the nightly batch lost about 8% of quotes.

citations.quote: The vendor returns 429 if two requests from the same account land within 3 seconds
Without the delay the nightly batch loses about 8% of quotes.

claims.text: I called it a hack when I wrote it. I said the proper fix was a queue.

citations.quote: hack: wait 3s before calling the tax vendor

claims.text: By Tom's commit, the file carried a TODO to remove the delay after migrating to the new tax vendor. That comment was already there as context in his diff.

citations.quote: // TODO: remove this delay after migrating to the new tax vendor

claims.text: I can't say who added the TODO comment, or whether the vendor migration ever happened.
claims.silenceReason: The ledger doesn't show which commit added the TODO or whether the new tax vendor migration happened.

answer.voice: Dmitri Volkov, first person, plain and a bit rueful about the hack
